feed_title: XL Orthopaedic Memory Foam Dog Bed 122 x 89cm, Three Bolsters with Open Front, Waterproof Liner, Short Plush Cover, Non Slip Base | PawLunova Staveley
descriptionHtml:
122 × 89cm. The arm of the sofa, without the sofa.

Staveley is an extra large orthopaedic memory foam dog bed, 122 × 89cm, with three bolsters, an open front, a waterproof inner lining and a short-plush cover.

They have a corner, and it is the arm of your settee. They back into it, lean, and are asleep within a minute. On a flat mat in the middle of the room, the same dog circles and gets up again.

At 122 × 89cm there is around 70% more floor area than a typical 90 × 70cm large bed, with three cushioned sides to press into.

What they get

  • Memory foam inside a waterproof lining: With an egg-crate profiled layer, wrapped so accidents do not reach it.
  • Three cushioned sides: A sofa edge for a resting chin or a sideways lean.
  • No full-height wall at the front: They walk straight in and it never feels boxed.
  • Short-plush cover and non-skid base: The cover unzips and the bed holds its spot.

Best for: big dogs who sleep pressed against something, and hard living-room floors.

Why it is worth the money

A big dog fits on 122 × 89cm rather than around it. Inside is memory foam instead of loose filling, wrapped in a waterproof lining. Spread £165 over the 1825 nights the foam guarantee runs and it is about 9p a night. The money is not stuck either. Within 100 nights we arrange free collection from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

We publish the footprint for Staveley but not its depth. If height is what you are deciding on, ask before you order.

Staveley or Melbreak? Staveley has the short-plush cover and the non-skid base. Melbreak has a textured plush surface and a three-sided cover opening.

Size and fit

SizeOutside length × width (cm)Suits
Extra Large122 × 89Big dogs who lean rather than sprawl

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. The bolsters take up some of the outside footprint. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Unzip the short-plush cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most

Will 122cm take my dog?

Measure them side-on and add 15 to 20cm before you compare.

Do I pay for delivery?

Not above £40. Timings sit beside the basket button.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment options appear at checkout.

How deep is the bed?

No depth figure is published for this one.

Any good for an old boy?

No wall across the front to negotiate. Your vet covers the rest.

Can I actually wash it?

The short-plush cover unzips and goes by its label.

What if it sits unused?

Tell us within 100 nights and the refund is full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
